verdict.rationale: gstack is an opinionated skill and tool pack for AI coding agents, so asking whether it offers official SDKs is a fair question. The evidence never mentions any official SDK or client library for building against it programmatically. The typed TypeScript host config objects are an internal extension mechanism for adding agent hosts, not an SDK, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
